meta.name: tdd-workflow
meta.description: Run a strict test-driven-development loop for AI-agent implementation, following Anthropic's published guidance for Claude Code: write the test first, watch it fail, define the minimum implementation contract, verify green after service-implementation, refactor under green, and produce evidence the agent did not silently overfit to the test. Use whenever a new feature, bug fix, refactor, or design hypothesis must be implemented with a verifiable safety net rather than after-the-fact tests.

copy.tagline: 先写测试再写代码，逐步交付有保障的功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你希望每次改动都有测试兜底。
copy.tagline_en: Write tests first, then code, ensuring safe step-by-step delivery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want every change backed by tests.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先写一个会失败的测试，然后自己或让另一技能实现最小代码让它通过，再重构并补充边界/负面测试。最后输出哪些验收标准已被覆盖的报告，证明没有悄悄针对测试取巧。
howto.when: 当你要实现新功能、修复bug或重构代码等改动时触发。Claude会先写测试并确认它失败，再按测试驱动流程完成实现。

say.text: 用 TDD 流程实现登录功能，先写测试。
say.note: Claude 会先写一个失败测试，再实现代码使其通过。

say.text: 帮我修复这个 bug，按 TDD 来：先写失败测试。
say.note: Claude 会先复现 bug 的失败测试，再修复代码。

say.text: 为一个设计假设写测试并实现最小代码来验证。
say.note: Claude 会按 TDD 步骤验证假设并给出结果。

howto.what_en: Claude writes a failing test first, then ensures minimal code makes it pass (itself or via another skill), refactors, adds negative tests, and reports coverage with anti-overfit evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to implement a new feature, fix a bug, or refactor code (or similar). Claude writes a failing test first, then follows TDD to complete the change.

say_en.text: Implement login using TDD workflow, write the test first.
say_en.note: Claude will write a failing test, then code to pass it.

say_en.text: Fix this bug with TDD: write a failing test first.
say_en.note: Claude will reproduce the bug in a failing test first.

say_en.text: Write a test for a design hypothesis and implement minimal code to verify.
say_en.note: Claude will run the TDD loop to validate the hypothesis.
